section.title: Long output spill
section.subtitle: Past the threshold the output goes to a file; the model reads the first and last lines and follows the path when it needs more
field.thresholdChars.label: Spill to a file past this many characters
field.thresholdChars.help: Tool output longer than this is written to a file, and the model only gets the first few lines plus a note on how to read on. Short output passes through unchanged.
field.keepLines.label: Lines kept in the preview
field.keepLines.help: A few lines from each end: the start shows what this output is, the end often carries errors and totals; the middle is left out and the model follows the path when it needs it.
field.readChunkLines.label: Lines per follow-up read
field.readChunkLines.help: This is the limit in the read(path=…, offset=…, limit=…) line inside the preview.
field.maxBytes.label: Byte limit per file
field.maxBytes.help: Past it the file is cut on a whole line, and the file ends with a note saying from which line nothing was written.
field.retentionDays.label: Days to keep
field.retentionDays.help: Counted from the last modification time; expired files are deleted at the next cleanup.
field.maxTotalBytes.label: Total bytes for the directory
field.maxTotalBytes.help: Past it the oldest files are deleted first; the one just written is never deleted.
field.dir.label: Spill directory
field.dir.help: Directories get mode 0700, files 0600. Another drive letter is fine; the directory is created on the first spill.
field.usage.label: Current contents
field.cleanup.label: Clean the spill directory now
field.cleanup.help: Runs both rules above once: expired files first, then the oldest until the total is back under the limit.
save.dirEmpty: The spill directory cannot be empty.
